Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Hearts of Three", "unit": 23, "heading": "CHAPTER XXI", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "ru78-u023-r0012", "target": "Один из копейщиков Королевы, шатаясь, вошёл в покои, его ноги тщетно расползались, пытаясь удержать его, глаза мутнели, губы бились, силясь передать беззвучную весть, которую его угасающая жизнь не могла произнести, и он упал ничком, со спиной, ощетинившейся стрелами, как у дикобраза. Генри бросился к двери, ведущей с моста, и из своего автоматического пистолета очистил её от наступавших Потерянных Душ, которые могли идти лишь по одному и падали на ходу под его огнём.", "source_sha256": "28c0c34b454ed49cb44dd7d728cc7398c09277be507e4eb2f264b0e097710067", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u023-r0012", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "760d62afdf2f2c8d89937fa8281b9aa26a944476626484ad248b8d8440c2b21d"}, {"source_id": "ru78-u023-r0013", "target": "Осада хрупкого дома была недолгой. Хотя Фрэнсис, прикрытый автоматом Генри, разрушил мост, осаждённые никак не могли потушить пылающую соломенную крышу, подожжённую в десятках мест зажигательными стрелами, пущенными по указаниям Жреца Солнца.", "source_sha256": "a07fffe1bf34a660e21b5ac650268b16ddbc0f0427f352729c99ba1d5c5c22f9", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u023-r0013", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "53cfae4a2f50e51f81e1387adaa89d197e93a5a02edfd2dd5015ef0a26095c2a"}]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "ru78-u023-r0014", "tag": "p", "text": "“There is but one way to escape,” the Queen panted, on the platform overlooking the whirl of waters, as she clasped one hand of Francis in hers and threatened to precipitate herself clingingly into his arms. “It wins to the world.” She pointed to the sucking heart of the whirlpool. “No one has ever returned from that. In my Mirror I have beheld them pass, dead always, and out to the wider world. Except for Torres, I have never seen the living go. Only the dead. And they never returned. Nor has Torres returned.”", "sha256": "663818b6d14ea4a99e6d3b36d29254d4172fd2dbd26251eaf496e41ef7c0d90e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1920]", "source_html": "

“There is but one way to escape,” the Queen panted, on the platform overlooking the whirl of waters, as she clasped one hand of Francis in hers and threatened to precipitate herself clingingly into his arms. “It wins to the world.” She pointed to the sucking heart of the whirlpool. “No one has ever returned from that. In my Mirror I have beheld them pass, dead always, and out to the wider world. Except for Torres, I have never seen the living go. Only the dead. And they never returned. Nor has Torres returned.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0016", "tag": "p", "text": "“There is no other way?” Henry demanded, as he drew Leoncia close to him.", "sha256": "f20b5adccdbf5aa9952603e9fcf93c7993f3c9a876feeae1ade8f8f431def93d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1922]", "source_html": "

“There is no other way?” Henry demanded, as he drew Leoncia close to him.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0017", "tag": "p", "text": "The Queen shook her head. About them already burning portions of the thatch were falling, while their ears were deafened by the blood-lust chantings of the Lost Souls on the lake-shore. The Queen disengaged her hand from Francis’, with the evident intention of dashing into her sleeping room, then caught his hand and led him in. As he stood wonderingly beside her, she slammed down the lid on the chest of jewels and fastened it. Next, she kicked aside the floor matting and lifted a trap door that opened down to the water. At her indication, Francis dragged over the chest and dropped it through.", "sha256": "a73a25da7eb9493ca1e2e42e63023505806a33efc2b5f6601abfd917b7fce8f6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1923]", "source_html": "

The Queen shook her head. About them already burning portions of the thatch were falling, while their ears were deafened by the blood-lust chantings of the Lost Souls on the lake-shore. The Queen disengaged her hand from Francis’, with the evident intention of dashing into her sleeping room, then caught his hand and led him in. As he stood wonderingly beside her, she slammed down the lid on the chest of jewels and fastened it. Next, she kicked aside the floor matting and lifted a trap door that opened down to the water. At her indication, Francis dragged over the chest and dropped it through.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0018", "tag": "p", "text": "“Even the Sun Priest does not know that hiding place,” she whispered, ere she caught his hand again, and, running, led him back to the others on the platform.", "sha256": "1f1d774b48d15341659634122a7fcd2c5f18111df59df8e3c0831b66e6ebf1e0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1924]", "source_html": "

“Even the Sun Priest does not know that hiding place,” she whispered, ere she caught his hand again, and, running, led him back to the others on the platform.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0019", "tag": "p", "text": "“It is now time to depart from this place,” she announced.", "sha256": "57af1ac3dacc329d368cff9f2aaf9b6d3276cacd0f19a58d5d31c267d03fbe2d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1925]", "source_html": "

“It is now time to depart from this place,” she announced.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0020", "tag": "p", "text": "“Hold me in your arms, good Francis, husband of mine, and lift me and leap with me,” she commanded. “We will lead the way.”", "sha256": "cf788a676582a283bbe3d4ef04b0e4f6566246bba6e7fd2468d4731151677ecc", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1926]", "source_html": "

208“Hold me in your arms, good Francis, husband of mine, and lift me and leap with me,” she commanded. “We will lead the way.”

As the roof was crashing down in a wrath of fire and flying embers, Henry caught Leoncia to him, and sprang after into the whirl of waters wherein Francis and the Queen had already disappeared.", "sha256": "79b48ca41f194ff8c4da9258c8d54965466cd8d5da3fbc96285323943d171010", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1927]", "source_html": "

And so they leapt. As the roof was crashing down in a wrath of fire and flying embers, Henry caught Leoncia to him, and sprang after into the whirl of waters wherein Francis and the Queen had already disappeared.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0022", "tag": "p", "text": "Like Torres, the four fugitives escaped injury against the rocks and were borne onward by the underground river to the daylight opening where the great spider-web guarded the way. Henry had an easier time of it, for Leoncia knew how to swim. But Francis’ swimming prowess enabled him to keep the Queen up. She obeyed him implicitly, floating low in the water, nor clutched at his arms nor acted as a drag on him in any way. At the ledge, all four drew out of the water and rested. The two women devoted themselves to wringing out their hair, which had been flung adrift all about them by the swirling currents.", "sha256": "5cd25aeb5899ca206f777cb1af0500b959adf688b8813d201bcac2a79529a0fd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1928]", "source_html": "

Like Torres, the four fugitives escaped injury against the rocks and were borne onward by the underground river to the daylight opening where the great spider-web guarded the way. Henry had an easier time of it, for Leoncia knew how to swim. But Francis’ swimming prowess enabled him to keep the Queen up. She obeyed him implicitly, floating low in the water, nor clutched at his arms nor acted as a drag on him in any way. At the ledge, all four drew out of the water and rested. The two women devoted themselves to wringing out their hair, which had been flung adrift all about them by the swirling currents.

“It is not the first mountain I have been in the heart of with you two,” Leoncia laughed to the Morgans, although more than for them was her speech intended for the Queen.

“It is the first time I have been in the heart of a mountain with my husband,” the Queen laughed back, and the barb of her dart sank deep into Leoncia.

“Seems as though your wife, Francis, and my wife-to-be, aren’t going to hit it off too well together,” Henry said, with the sharpness of censure that man is wont to employ to conceal the embarrassment caused by his womankind.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0026", "tag": "p", "text": "And, as inevitable result of such male men’s ways, all that Henry gained was a silence more awkward and more embarrassing. The two women almost enjoyed the situation. Francis cudgeled his brains vainly for some remark that would ameliorate matters; while Henry, in desperation, arose suddenly with the observation that he was going to “explore a bit,” and invited, by his hand out to help her to her feet, the Queen to accompany him. Francis and Leoncia sat on for a moment in stubborn silence. And, as inevitable result of such male men’s ways, all that Henry gained was a silence more awkward and more embarrassing. The two women almost enjoyed the situation. Francis and Leoncia sat on for a moment in stubborn silence. He was the first to break it.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0027", "tag": "p", "text": "“For two cents I’d give you a thorough shaking, Leoncia.”", "sha256": "704ebdf4300a3181249652a8fdcb63c0b13cd2e0f4de409b7285cd55acfba2d0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1933]", "source_html": "

“For two cents I’d give you a thorough shaking, Leoncia.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0028", "tag": "p", "text": "“And what have I done now?” she countered.", "sha256": "4cb7cda628237618651eddf45856927303d444139776d2de135deb27c3efabb1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1934]", "source_html": "

“And what have I done now?” she countered.
